tldr: Mercury through the 11th house clarifies friends, groups, community, networks, and future plans.
body:
When Mercury moves through your 11th house, it puts language around friends, groups, audience, networks, community, hopes, and where you belong. You may notice who you are connected to, which groups still feel alive, and what kind of future you want to be part of.

Something may need to be said, decided, written, questioned, or understood. It can help you name the question, make the call, or sort through the moving pieces.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for seeing where belonging supports you and where it has become performative.

The caution: Watch for overthinking the situation until the simple next step disappears. The risk is staying attached to a group, plan, or audience that no longer fits.

Mercury moves through this house for a few weeks. Use the mental activity for clarity. Say the thing plainly, then let the answer tell you what comes next.
